abstract: The expression of inhibin-alpha subunit has been described in normal placentas, hydatidiform moles, and trophoblastic tumors. We performed a double immunohistochemical expression analysis of inhibin-alpha and inhibin-beta subunits in a cytogenetically well characterized series of 21 complete and 22 partial hydatidiform moles, 2 placental site trophoblastic tumors, and one choriocarcinoma. Syncytiotrophoblastic cells were consistently inhibin-alpha and inhibin-beta positive in all hydatidiform moles and in the one choriocarcinoma. Cytotrophoblast was negative for both subunits in all trophoblastic lesions studied. While villous intermediate trophoblastic cells were consistently inhibin-alpha negative in all hydatidiform moles, focal inhibin-beta immunoreactivity was detected in villous intermediate trophoblast in approximately one third of complete and partial hydatidiform moles. Decidual stromal cells in 40 hydatidiform moles were inhibin-alpha and inhibin-beta positive in approximately one third of cases. Both placental site trophoblastic tumors were inhibin-alpha positive but inhibin-beta negative. Our findings indicate that inhibin-alpha and -beta subunits are consistently coexpressed in syncytiotrophoblast in complete and partial moles. Immunohistochemical detection of inhibin subunits may be useful in the differential diagnosis of trophoblastic lesions.
abstract_ja: インヒビンα・βサブユニットの発現について、細胞遺伝学的に十分に特徴づけられた21例の完全胞状奇胎、22例の部分胞状奇胎、2例の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、1例の絨毛癌を対象に二重免疫組織化学的解析を行った。合胞体栄養膜細胞は、すべての胞状奇胎および絨毛癌で両サブユニットが一貫して陽性であった。細胞栄養膜は、すべての栄養膜病変で両サブユニットが陰性であった。絨毛中間型栄養膜細胞は、すべての胞状奇胎でインヒビンα陰性であったが、完全・部分奇胎の約3分の1では絨毛中間型栄養膜にβの限局性免疫反応が認められた。胞状奇胎40例の脱落膜間質細胞は、約3分の1の症例でインヒビンα・βともに陽性であった。胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍2例はいずれもインヒビンα陽性・β陰性であった。以上より、インヒビンαおよびβサブユニットは完全・部分奇胎の合胞体栄養膜で一貫して共発現していることが示された。インヒビンサブユニットの免疫組織化学的検出は、栄養膜病変の鑑別診断に有用な可能性がある。
